derivation: Earliest EX.EXSTDTC among valid doses (EXDOSE > 0, or EXDOSE = 0 and EXTRT contains 'PLACEBO'); missing time imputed as 00:00:00

label: Datetime of Last Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Latest EX.EXENDTC among valid doses (same rule as TRTSDTM); missing time imputed as 23:59:59

Intent-To-Treat Population Flag
derivation: 'Y' if DM.ARM is not 'Screen Failure' (randomized); else 'N'

label: Safety Population Flag
derivation: 'Y' if TRTSDT is not missing (at least one valid dose); else 'N'

label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event

Analysis Start Date
derivation: AE.AESTDTC as date; missing day/month imputed to the earliest possible date, but not earlier than TRTSDT

label: Analysis Start Date Imputation Flag
derivation: 'D' if day imputed; 'M' if month and day imputed; else missing

label: Analysis End Date
derivation: AE.AEENDTC as date; missing day/month imputed to the latest possible date; missing if AEENDTC missing (ongoing)

label: Analysis Start Relative Day
derivation: ASTDT - TRTSDT + 1 if ASTDT >= TRTSDT; else ASTDT - TRTSDT (no day 0)

label: Analysis End Relative Day
derivation: AENDT - TRTSDT + 1 if AENDT >= TRTSDT; else AENDT - TRTSDT (no day 0)

label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
derivation: 'Y' if ASTDT >= TRTSDT and ASTDT <= TRTEDT + 30 days; else missing

label: Analysis Relative Day
derivation: ADT - TRTSDT + 1 if ADT >= TRTSDT; else ADT - TRTSDT (no day 0)

label: Analysis Visit
derivation: 'Baseline' for the ABLFL = 'Y' record; scheduled post-baseline LB.VISIT (e.g. 'Week 2'); missing for unscheduled visits and pre-treatment records not selected as baseline

label: Analysis Visit (N)
derivation: 0 for Baseline; week number for scheduled post-baseline visits

label: Analysis Reference Range Indicator
derivation: 'LOW' if AVAL < ANRLO; 'HIGH' if AVAL > ANRHI; else 'NORMAL'; missing if AVAL or both limits missing

label: Baseline Record Flag
derivation: 'Y' for the last record with non-missing AVAL and ADT <= TRTSDT, per USUBJID and PARAMCD (ties broken by highest LBSEQ)

label: Baseline Value
derivation: AVAL from the ABLFL = 'Y' record, per USUBJID and PARAMCD

label: Baseline Reference Range Indicator
derivation: ANRIND from the ABLFL = 'Y' record, per USUBJID and PARAMCD

label: Change from Baseline
derivation: AVAL - BASE for post-baseline records (ADT > TRTSDT)

label: Percent Change from Baseline
derivation: (AVAL - BASE) / BASE * 100 for post-baseline records; missing if BASE = 0

label: Shift 1
derivation: 'BNRIND to ANRIND' (e.g. 'NORMAL to HIGH') for post-baseline records
